description: Mali: Bamako Roads Network is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Mali. The geodata represents the roads network in Bamako, Mali. The data is provided by MINUSMA GIS. Coverage: Mali. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Mali. Its tags are facilities-infrastructure, geodata, logistics, roads. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-05-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
